description: SML2010 records a monitored smart house for indoor-environment prediction. Romeu-Guallart and Zamora-Martinez publish 4,137 records covering approximately forty days, with minute observations smoothed into fifteen-minute means in UTC. Two text files include indoor and outdoor temperatures, room carbon dioxide, humidity, lighting, wind, facade illumination, solar irradiance and motor on/off states. The variable descriptions give units such as degrees Celsius, ppm, lux and watts per square metre. Spatial coverage is one house, but its location and exact calendar dates are not stated on the inspected page. UCI supplies the files free under CC BY 4.0; headers are documented as Spanish. A limitation is possible missing values and smoothing that removes short transients relevant to rapid control responses. Simulation uses include calibrating indoor-temperature surrogates and testing building monitoring logic. It complements model-energyplus with observations, not an executable building model. No file was downloaded, and agreement with any EnergyPlus configuration has not been tested.
